title: docs(data-objectstack): stop documenting `MetadataCache` as constructible (objectui#8320)
body:
Fixes #8320

## What this changes

`MetadataCache`'s class docblock carried an `@example` whose first line was a direct
construction of the class. `@object-ui/data-objectstack` declares exactly one export key
(`.`), and the class is not reachable through it: `src/index.ts` imports it directly, and
`ObjectStackAdapter` keeps it in a `private` field built from `config.cache`. A reader
copying that example could not get past line one.

**Route taken: option 2 of the card — stop documenting it as public.** The example is
removed and the docblock now states plainly that the class is package-internal and names
the route a reader can actually take: `createObjectStackAdapter`'s `cache` option (same
`{ maxSize, ttl }` object, and it carries a worked example of its own), and `getCached` /
`getCacheStats` / `invalidateCache` / `clearCache` on the adapter. The package README's
"Metadata Caching" section is the long-form version of the same route.

⛔ The class is **not** exported to make the example importable. That would add a supported
public class on the evidence of one docblock.

## The reproduction, and the proof

Both readings come from the SAME harness the objectui#8258 gate's verdict uses
(`analyze` + `compileSnippets` from `scripts/check-doc-snippet-types.mjs`), compiled
against the built `dist/*.d.ts`, so the answer comes from the same resolution the gate's
answer does — not from a manifest read.

| probe | before the fix | after the fix |
|---|---|---|
| SUBJECT `import { MetadataCache } from '@object-ui/data-objectstack'` | RED, TS2305 | RED, TS2305 |
| CONTROL `import { createObjectStackAdapter } from '@object-ui/data-objectstack'` | GREEN, 0 diagnostics | GREEN, 0 diagnostics |

The control is green in **both** worlds — that is what makes it a control, and it is what
validates the instrument on a known positive before any zero is quoted from it. The
subject is red in both worlds on purpose: this pull request does not make that import
work, it removes the documentation that instructed it. Its being red **after** the change
is the evidence that the public entry point was not widened.

`pnpm check:doc-examples`, exit 0 both before and after, with exactly one row moving:

```
before:  233 @example tags -> 125 blocks   |  114 of 115 documented symbol(s) are importable
                                           |  NOT importable from any probed specifier: @object-ui/data-objectstack MetadataCache
         125 block(s) - 35 compile, 90 fail, 90 declared in the ledger (90 rows)

after:   232 @example tags -> 124 blocks   |  114 of 114 documented symbol(s) are importable
                                           |  (the NOT-importable line is gone)
         124 block(s) - 35 compile, 89 fail, 89 declared in the ledger (89 rows)
```

One tag, one block, one pair, one ledger row. Everything else is unmoved: 107 injections,
35 compiling blocks, and the same 3 symbols reached only through their module's built
declaration.

## Why one line of the gate script is touched, and only one

The ledger row `packages/data-objectstack/src/cache/MetadataCache.ts:56 MetadataCache` is
deleted. That is not a change to the gate — it is what the ledger's own contract requires:
"a row naming a block that is gone -> RED, stale". Ablation on the committed tree, with
the row re-inserted and then restored:

```
== marker count before mutation: 0 (expect 0)
== marker count after mutation: 1 (expect 1)     <- mutation proven on disk, blob changed
   check:doc-examples EXIT=1
   STALE LEDGER ROW  packages/data-objectstack/src/cache/MetadataCache.ts:56 MetadataCache
     no such example in the scan set
   vitest EXIT=1
   x every row names a block that is actually in the compiled tier
== RESTORED: git diff HEAD is empty and the blob matches HEAD
```

⛔ Nothing else in that gate is touched: not its logic, not its funnel prose, not
`scripts/__tests__/check-doc-example-types.test.ts`, not the root manifest's `check:` line.
The other two pairs the card's transcript named as unimportable are not touched either —
and on this base they no longer read that way at all: objectui#8743's built-twin candidate
now reaches `validateSchema` and `safeValidateSchema`, so the census reports **one**
unimportable pair, not three, and it is this card's.

## Nothing published moves

- The class docblock never reaches `dist/*.d.ts` — measured with a positive control
  (`MetadataCacheStats`' docblock, which does ship: 1 hit; this one: 0 hits).
- After a full rebuild of `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, all four published artifacts are
  byte-for-byte identical: `dist/index.js` `ac763ff83…`, `dist/index.cjs` `16931c09f…`,
  `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.cts` `a3df9f3ae…` — same hashes before and after.
- Hence the changeset declares an **empty frontmatter**: a declaration that this releases
  nothing. `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` exit 0 and says so.

## Clause-2

`Clause-2: no` — declared on the claim comment of #8320. No exported symbol is added or
removed, and no key moves on a published runtime payload; the diff is one JSDoc block on a
class that is not on any public entry, one stale ledger row, and a release-nothing
changeset, with the published bytes proven unchanged above.

## Gates run locally (at 856341654)

| check | verdict |
|---|---|
| `node scripts/check-doc-example-types.mjs` | exit 0 — "Every covered `@example` compiles, or fails exactly as its ledger row declares." |
| `pnpm exec vitest run scripts/__tests__/check-doc-example-types.test.ts` | exit 0 — 51 tests passed (verbose run, file named in the output) |
| `pnpm exec vitest run packages/data-objectstack/` | exit 0 — 61 files, 864 tests passed |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack run type-check` | exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit`) |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/data-objectstack run lint` | exit 0 — 0 errors, 445 pre-existing warnings |
| `pnpm exec eslint scripts/ --no-inline-config --format json` | exit 0 — 240 files, 0 errors, 8 warnings |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | exit 0 |
| `pnpm run check:doc-fences` | exit 0 |
| `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` | exit 0 — 7111 tracked text files scanned |
| `node scripts/check-comment-mask-corpus.mjs` | exit 0 — report, residue unchanged at the objectui#7882 ceiling |
| `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` | NOT GOVERNED — ordinary review and merge-queue route |

The repository-wide `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` are declared to CI. eslint here has no
type-aware linting configured (no `projectService`, no `parserOptions.project`), so this
diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not contain; the two trees it does touch
were linted whole, not sampled.

Merge with base: **no-op**. `origin/main` is still `93127bd6f`, the same commit this
branch was cut from — `git merge origin/main` reports "Already up to date." There was
nothing behind to catch up to on this run.

## Measured, deliberately not fixed

Filed as #8927: `packages/data-objectstack/README.md`'s "Concurrent Access" bullet says
concurrent requests for the same uncached key "may result in multiple fetcher calls",
which is the opposite of what `MetadataCache.get` does and the opposite of what
`MetadataCache.test.ts` pins. Different file, different defect, and a prose rewrite rather
than a mechanical edit — so it is a card, not a rider on this one.
